cache_dir.description: Primary cache directory — must be on an already-mounted filesystem with fscache support.

tag.description: Optional cache tag — useful when multiple caches are managed by a single host (e.g., for NFS server clustering).

debug.description: Debug verbosity level (0–5). Higher values produce more logging to syslog.

run_as_root.description: Run cachefilesd as root. If false, drops privileges to the specified user/group.

user.description: User account to drop privileges to when not running as root.

group.description: Group to drop privileges to (optional; only used if not run_as_root).

pidfile.description: Path to the PID file for the daemon.

extra_dirs.description: List of additional cache directories for tiered or mirrored caching.

cache_lower.description: Lower bound on cache size (e.g., '1G', '500M', '100K' or '0' for unlimited minimum).

cache_upper.description: Upper bound on cache size (e.g., '10G', '500M'). Cache will be pruned when exceeded.

scan_interval.description: Seconds between automatic cache scans. Set to 0 to disable scanning.
